title: Come My Soul Thy Suit Prepare
lyrics_original: Come, my soul, thy suit prepare:
Jesus loves to answer prayer;
He Himself has bid thee pray,
Therefore will not say thee nay;
Therefore will not say thee nay.
Thou art coming to a King,
Large petitions with thee bring;
For His grace and power are such,
None can ever ask too much;
None can ever ask too much.
With my burden I begin:
Lord, remove this load of sin;
Let Thy blood, for sinners spilt,
Set my conscience free from guilt;
Set my conscience free from guilt.
Lord, I come to Thee for rest,
Take possession of my breast;
There Thy blood bought right maintain,
And without a rival reign;
And without a rival reign.
While I am a pilgrim here,
Let Thy love my spirit cheer;
As my Guide, my Guard, my Friend,
Lead me to my journey's end;
Lead me to my journey's end.
Show me what I have to do,
Every hour my strength renew:
Let me live a life of faith,
Let me die Thy people's death;
Let me die Thy people's death.

bible_verses.english: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
Whatever you ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
Let’s therefore come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for inviting me to draw near to You with complete confidence. Forgive me for the times I hold back my needs, forgetting the boundless depth of Your love and power. Today, I bring my heavy burdens and greatest hopes before Your throne. Grant me a heart of bold faith, trusting that You hear every prayer and delight to answer. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we pray, we are not approaching a distant or reluctant ruler, but a gracious King who delights to answer our cries. Because Christ's love and power are boundless, no petition brought in sincere faith is ever too great for Him. Today, set aside every hesitation and come boldly to His throne of grace. Rest in the sweet assurance that the Savior who invited you to pray will never turn you away.
